The '''astrigia''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of fierce swooping predator with large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They lived in the forests of [[steepara tree]]s that covered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], and posed a constant threat to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] species who shared the planet with them.<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Astrigia were first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.
